description: This file is a polyfill implementation for the EventSource API, supporting server-sent events with fallback support for IE11 and other browsers. It includes classes and functions for handling event streams, XMLHttpRequest, fetch API, and related event handling mechanisms.

classes.name: TextDecoderPolyfill
classes.description: A polyfill for the TextDecoder class to support decoding UTF-8 in browsers that lack native support.

classes.name: XHRWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class around XMLHttpRequest to normalize behavior across different browsers and handle various edge cases.

classes.name: HeadersPolyfill
classes.description: A polyfill for the Headers object to parse and retrieve HTTP headers.

classes.name: HeadersWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for headers, providing a get method.

classes.name: EventTarget
classes.description: A custom implementation of an event target for dispatching and handling events.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A basic event class with a type property.

classes.name: MessageEvent
classes.description: An event class for message events, extending Event.

classes.name: ConnectionEvent
classes.description: An event class for connection-related events, extending Event.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a sequence of octets into a string, supporting UTF-8 decoding with fallback for unsupported browsers.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens an XMLHttpRequest or fetch request for server-sent events, with support for headers, credentials, and aborting.
